revision_reason: The first exploratory native run showed that a single Python 3.11 image and an immutable workspace confound metadata-derived recipes. The second exploratory freeze derives a supported Python image from project metadata and always runs tests from an ephemeral writable workspace copy.
purpose: Test whether deterministic repository metadata can improve executable-task recovery without using execution outcomes as recipe inputs.
project_root_rule: Choose the project marker directory that is an ancestor of the most frozen changed-test targets; break ties by shallower depth then lexical path.
test_target_rule: Reuse the already frozen changed-test targets; do not select targets from execution outcomes.

execution_environment_rule.python_image: Derive the lowest supported Python minor among 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 from project.requires-python when available; otherwise use Python 3.11.
execution_environment_rule.workspace: Run tests from an ephemeral writable copy while retaining a read-only container root filesystem.

success_interpretation: A recovered executable bundle is exploratory execution-infrastructure evidence only and cannot establish Utility or curation benefit.
failure_interpretation: Failure does not establish Stage-B, curation, or Utility failure.
confirmatory_use: forbidden until the rule is independently frozen for a fresh confirmatory execution pool
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Post-failure exploratory execution-recipe refinement only; no Utility, curation-benefit, or release claim.
